requirements:
Component: a steel clamp body, a block with a large bore and two arms, lying on one of its two large flat faces. A pad presses on the concave outer flank of one arm.

Geometry (CAD): geometry.step, in metres, scaled so its bounding-box diagonal is 100.0 mm. Faces are named f<tag> by their face tag in this STEP file; positions below are in mm.

Material: steel, isotropic and linear elastic; E = 210 GPa, Poisson's ratio 0.3.

Service loads: a uniform pressure of 2.1 MPa presses on face f7, the concave cylindrical flank of radius 27.77 mm (axis along z, centroid (26.53, -1.64, 0.00), area 457.1 mm^2), pushing into the part. No other face is loaded.

Installation and supports: face f12, the whole flat face on the plane z = -8.10 mm (outward normal along -z, centroid (0.00, -15.19, -8.10), area 2426.4 mm^2), is bonded over its whole area to a massive rigid table that does not move or deform. Nothing else touches the part.

Analysis scope: static, linear elastic, small deformations, no gravity; a solid (three-dimensional) model of the whole part.

Required result: strain_energy, the total strain energy of the part, in J.

mapping.implied_by: f12 is bonded over its whole area to a rigid table that does not move.
A uniform 2.1 MPa pressure pushes into f7.
A solid model of the whole part.
